messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Updated [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) so equal or worse completions keep the existing best, and [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) so a size without a record shows `Best: none`.

**Checks:** 140 unit tests passed; type checking and the fresh build passed. The browser suite had 76 journeys pass and one 30-second timeout in the 44px face distinction journey. That journey passed when rerun alone (28.4 seconds). The score and status journeys passed.
